method: Assistant visual review of full WAV waveforms, spectrograms, and enlarged ambiguous attacks; 22 ms isolated raw bass attack correlation used as an annotation aid, crosschecked with 40-300 Hz filtered waveform alignment. Command times locate broad search windows only. No learned model or training.

examples.notes: Expected bass impacts visible with natural decay; no extra bass impacts identified in full-clip review. Bass attack alignment retained after enlarged-attack review and filtered crosscheck. Accompaniment is context only; other instruments are not exhaustively labeled.
